title: Station Rotation: CHEM 3A Lab Practical — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice for the CHEM 3A lab practical. Mock Practical: 10 timed stations (4 minutes + 1 minute to rotate, then a 5-minute wrap-up), each showing Versions A, B and C; the student picks or draws a green, yellow or purple answer sheet and the screen turns that color. Answers are free response and graded like the real practical (value, sig figs and units). Practice by Lab: untimed questions with hints, worked answers and videos for every experiment: Lab Exploration, Making Measurements, Found or Forgery (flame tests, average atomic mass of lead), Rolling for Compound Initiative (naming), Empirical Formula, Molecular Modeling, Calorimetry, Gas Constant R, Solutions and Dilutions (standard curve), Types of Reactions, pH of Household Items, Citric Acid in Soda (titration), plus older labs (Electrons in Atoms, Law of Constant Composition, Synthesis of Alum). Drawn graduated cylinders, burets, gas collection tubes, thermometers, rulers, balances, test tube reactions, flame tests, cabbage indicator colors and ball-and-stick models. PhET Lab Bench: embedded PhET simulations with checked tasks. Add ?labs=dan to show only Dr. Dan's current lab list.
